scope: Exact approved74f118 literal and pinned unchanged coordinator/API/Host/Core/Steps; excludes outer setup/full-native/cleanup process totals.
process_count_formula: 10 preflight postgres +4 setup/postsetup +6*40 case-admin +5*1 issuer-admin +7*956 probe-admin =6951; plus8 other correct-auth +9 wrong-auth +4 metadata +998 operation launches =7970

evidence_writes.formula: 3 Evidence/main-input +49 preflight +1 setup-stage +6 setup-operation +7 postsetup +19*40 case-fixed +13 issuer +19*956 runnable-probe +2*4 blocked-probe +1 finish =19012
evidence_writes.every_save: json.dumps(entire growing value,indent=2), write temporary, flush, os.fsync, atomic replace
evidence_writes.same_record_alias_retention: operation assigns current=record and appends the same record to operations. Post-closure fingerprint mutates current, so each retained operation receives all42 data-projection rows and fingerprint checks.
evidence_writes.cumulative_cost_class: Quadratic growing snapshot rewrites; no retry is required for this cost.
evidence_writes.minimum_basis: For each of956 successful probes, its19 saves retain every earlier successful probe projection; 19*sum(range(956))*7119. The conservative7119-byte template uses only42 source-known names, source-fixed counts and64-character placeholder hashes, with less indentation than actual operations nesting. No synthetic evidence artifact or runtime value is produced.
evidence_writes.cost_excludes: All other record fields, current alias duplication, controls/setup, facets, authentication, native metadata and outer wrapper saves.

wait_and_closure_source_bounds.normal_reap_escalation: one wait10; if timeout/broken pipe terminate+wait10; then kill+wait10
wait_and_closure_source_bounds.outer_coordinator_call: Synchronous module.main in redirect_stdout/redirect_stderr, with global closure boundary on return/throw; no whole-coordinator timeout.
wait_and_closure_source_bounds.quiet_stdout: Coordinator Evidence.stage/save does not print progress; outer redirects all coordinator stdout/stderr until it returns.

boundedness_limits_separate_from_expecte.finding: Finite40/24 loops and per-call timeouts do not impose a whole-run deadline; no elapsed-time or process-call-count watchdog wraps module.main.

stdin.write/flush are synchronous and have no explicit timeout. capture queue timeout and finish20s deadline begin after send returns; cleanup reap also writes before wait10. A stalled transport could therefore block outside those timers. No stall is observed by this analysis.
JSON serialization/write/fsync/replace are synchronous and not covered by a timer. Source proves repeated durable work, not current storage latency or a hung call.

while_loops_only: finish queue loop with monotonic20s deadline
finite_control_flow_findings.reader_lifetime: Read loops end on EOF/error; normal close reaps process and bounded joins reject live readers. They do not retry cases/probes.
finite_control_flow_findings.first_unexpected: operation raises, coordinator main catches and returns2; no continuation/retry of later cases.
finite_control_flow_findings.Root_callbacks: Coordinator uses pinned API.run/psql with explicit immutableCID. API.run launches one Docker exec per call. Host.inspect_live/verify_image are pure comparators, not hidden per-probe Docker calls.

duration_interpretation.meaning: Large sequential breadth plus at least57.5GiB of lower-bound repeated JSON text is sufficient to make a long quiet run plausible. The85-minute report alone cannot distinguish progress from a stalled call; this is not an observed throughput measurement or remaining-time estimate.

not_done: No assertion about current progress/stage, current failure cause, verdict, cleanup or remaining time
